prompt.project_info: Create a highly realistic urban lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman standing on a train platform.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with medium dark-brown hair tied in a low ponytail with soft bangs, wearing a beige ribbed high-neck cropped sweater, black leather jacket, flowing black midi skirt, and off-white canvas tote. She stands calmly looking to the side.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium full-body eye-level portrait with yellow train, tracks, metal station roof, platform edge markings, and slightly softened background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even overcast daylight, neutral palette contrasted by bright yellow train, candid modern urban mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 35mm vertical portrait, realistic leather, knit, hair, train, rails, and architectural texture.
